feature_verification.how_run: executed against the real backend modules under the pytest environment (the module import chain needs conftest); the only mock is the stream generator, which is the transport
covers: the tool validates an agent-authored surface, streams it as one envelope per NDJSON chunk with no text content, and ends the turn (return_direct, empty return)
envelope order createSurface -> updateComponents -> updateDataModel, advertising the official Basic Catalog id
the capability declaration parses from the exact wire payload the frontend sends (a2uiSupportedCatalogs) — the CR-001 regression
a well-formed structured answer is accepted against the stored surface

eight tampering vectors are refused with a precise 422: an option never offered, a date past the declared max, the same date made timezone-aware, a value failing the declared regexp, an unbound data-model key, an action name no Button offers, an unknown surface, and a catalogId smuggled into the action envelope
both the question and the structured answer are materialized into the text replayed to the LLM next turn
the tool refuses to emit a surface with no submit control, so the model is corrected at authoring time
feature_verification.not_covered_here: Browser rendering of the 18 components, the streaming and read-only UX states, and the re-answer flow are covered by the frontend suites (including one test that mounts the chat block against a real valtio store) but not by an end-to-end browser run — that is the manual testing stage, which is deliberately not entered.
